Differential Prompt Functioning (DPF) & Measurement Invariance Test

Source: R/dpf.R
dpf_test.Rd

Tests whether LLM-generated scores exhibit uniform (intercept shift) or non-uniform (slope difference) bias across observed demographic or experimental subgroups conditional on human gold-standard scores. Adapts nested OLS / logistic Differential Item Functioning (DIF) regression frameworks (Swaminathan & Rogers, 1990; Zumbo, 1999) to LLM coding pipelines, with automatic unit-clustered sandwich inference when units appear across multiple prompts or models, per-prompt FDR screening, and a global prompt x group interaction test.

Usage

dpf_test(
  data,
  score_col = "score",
  truth_col = "human_score",
  group_col = "group",
  prompt_col = NULL,
  id_col = NULL,
  family = c("auto", "gaussian", "binomial"),
  poly_degree = 1L,
  alpha = 0.05,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

An llm_coded_data object or a data.frame.

score_col

Name of the LLM score column (numeric for "gaussian", or binary {0,1} / logical / 2-level factor for "binomial").

truth_col

Name of the numeric human gold-standard (matching criterion) column.

group_col

Name of the categorical subgroup column (at least 2 levels).

prompt_col

Optional name of a prompt column. When supplied with at least 2 levels, runs per-prompt DPF screening (with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR-adjusted p-values) and a global prompt x group interaction test.

id_col

Optional name of the unit identifier column. When repeated observations exist per unit, cluster-robust sandwich Wald tests are used to prevent pseudoreplication Type-I error inflation.

family

Outcome family: "auto" (detects binary vs continuous), "gaussian", or "binomial".

poly_degree

Positive integer polynomial degree for the matching criterion truth_col. Default 1L (linear matching).

alpha

Significance threshold for flagging DPF. Default 0.05.

na.rm

Logical; drop rows with missing values. Default TRUE.

Value

An S3 object of class "llm_dpf" containing:

  • tests: tibble of nested hypothesis tests (uniform, nonuniform, omnibus) with test statistics, df, p-values, \(\Delta R^2\), Cohen's \(f^2\) (Gaussian), magnitude classification, and flagged.

  • subgroup_summary: tibble of per-subgroup raw bias, conditional bias at mean gold-standard score (with SE and 95% CI), conditional slope, RMSE, and correlation.

  • prompt_dpf: tibble of per-prompt DPF tests with BH-adjusted p-values (or NULL if prompt_col is NULL).

  • prompt_interaction_test: tibble testing prompt x group interaction controlling for truth_col (or NULL).

  • dpf_detected: logical scalar indicating omnibus DPF at alpha.

  • clustered: logical indicating whether unit-clustered inference was used.

  • family, reference_group, models, score_col, truth_col, group_col, prompt_col, alpha, data.

Examples

data(ema_coded)
agg <- aggregate_scores(ema_coded, score_col = "llm_score")
res <- dpf_test(agg, score_col = "llm_score", truth_col = "human_score", group_col = "group")
res
#> 
#> ── Differential Prompt Functioning (DPF) Diagnostics 
#> Family: gaussian | Reference group: "group_a" | Clustered: FALSE | DPF
#> detected: TRUE
#> # A tibble: 3 × 7
#>   test       statistic    df p_value delta_r2 magnitude  flagged
#>   <chr>          <dbl> <dbl> <chr>      <dbl> <chr>      <lgl>  
#> 1 uniform       88.1       1 <0.0001   0.0776 large      TRUE   
#> 2 nonuniform     0.998     1 0.3230    0.0009 negligible FALSE  
#> 3 omnibus       44.6       2 <0.0001   0.0784 large      TRUE
